name: Supervisor approval moves the request to the HR queue

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and log in with email 'flow.full@leave-portal.test' and password 'password' using the 'Log in' button.
Open the 'New Request' page (URL /requests/create), select 'Annual Leave', set Start date to 2026-11-02 and End date to 2026-11-04, enter reason 'E2E supreq marker' and click 'Submit request'.
Click the 'Log out' icon button in the top-right corner of the page.
Log in with email 'supervisor@leave-portal.test' and password 'password'.
Open the 'Supervisor Queue' page via the sidebar link (URL /approvals/supervisor).
In the table, find the row for employee 'Flow Full' whose reason is 'E2E supreq marker' and click its 'Approve' button.
In the confirmation dialog that opens, click the 'Approve' submit button (not 'Cancel').
The request is no longer shown in the supervisor queue.
Click the 'Log out' icon button, then log in with email 'hr@leave-portal.test' and password 'password'.
Open the 'HR Queue' page via the sidebar link (URL /hr/approvals).
The request for employee 'Flow Full' with reason 'E2E supreq marker' is now present in the HR queue.
